body:
#

Hello,
It’s Scott Kelly — Mark Kelly’s twin brother (also an astronaut!).
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260526-1-SBase&refcode2=11500.3935704.m-MQqO&t=1&akid=11500%2E3935704%2Em-MQqO)_(I’m the one on the left.)_
I know Mark and Gabby pretty well, better than most. To know them is to know one thing: **_Don’t ever — not even for one moment — underestimate them.**_
On January 8, 2011, I was commanding the International Space Station (ISS) when Gabby was shot at a constituent event. It rocked our family forever.
Throughout the next few weeks, I called Mark every day on the phone as he updated me on Gabby’s condition. I traveled to see them immediately after landing.
I am in awe of Gabby. It’s now been fifteen years since that terrible day, but Gabby hasn’t stopped fighting — not only for herself, but for our families across the country.
But the truth is, not everybody likes that. That’s exactly why the NRA is working so hard to attack Gabby and the incredible work she’s accomplished at GIFFORDS.
It’s never easy watching your family get attacked, but I’m so grateful to know you have their back. Together, you have helped them stand up to the gun lobby and pass more than 820 gun safety laws. That’s no small feat.
But as the attacks ramp up ahead of the midterm elections, Gabby can’t win this fight alone. So I have an important request:
**[Will you please chip in $3 to stand with Gabby? GIFFORDS PAC is working to reach undecided voters and take on the gun lobby’s influence in our politics, but she needs your help.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260526-1-SBase&t=2&akid=11500%2E3935704%2Em-MQqO)

We're taking the fight somewhere Democrats have long been unwilling to go: taking aggressive action to reclaim control of the U.S. Supreme Court.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h1awpblQk8HOtXFvvgWNWP-2TTBr6th73S-gSKCL8bn9oGHRCawfee3ludd8WvHDoUKIKJuQn55nVlkREt5z4o_wikMZCM0rFPeHuqUAH6UfTeW5tBQUeAircKWbiDM6bE-7v5U-utQygNT0PAyaTZlpY-5cpwu_blOoWfkLyVBJ28B27I_D6tx-3Vgzv78rKbI4iw-LAvGyjVUSwTnOBAhc4Ip4hljtrCiJQHuLdnGpeO5NeT0ddw==&c=8Mj1P479jvZmW-C6LCbCfXoLxxjYQzknH29BC2l56ZhwHbLWTraM9g==&ch=-tPbucq-R4A58VPk9g2-JI7cOj5xhjYSbXodic-D5Gd-kCZEoDp4Bw==)

|
Peter,
When Defend Our Courts launched in Spring 2025, we had one mission: defend state courts, from Donald Trump and the MAGA extremists seizing control and weaponizing them to rig elections.
We were one of the first Democratic organizations to sound the alarm about Trump's election-rigging plot. We saw it coming not because we had a crystal ball, but because we were willing to face what others weren't: Trump will do whatever it takes to stay in power, and right-wing extremists have spent decades building the infrastructure to help him.
So we went to work. We rallied hundreds of thousands of voters around obscure state Supreme Court elections. We raised millions and flooded the airwaves. We caught MAGA's dark money machine completely flat-footed. When the dust settled, we had secured pro-democracy majorities on the Pennsylvania and Wisconsin Supreme Courts through 2030, two key swing state courts Trump now cannot touch.
Now we're taking the fight somewhere Democrats have long been unwilling to go: taking aggressive action to reclaim control of the U.S. Supreme Court.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h1awpblQk8HOtXFvvgWNWP-2TTBr6th73S-gSKCL8bn9oGHRCawfee3ludd8WvHDoUKIKJuQn55nVlkREt5z4o_wikMZCM0rFPeHuqUAH6UfTeW5tBQUeAircKWbiDM6bE-7v5U-utQygNT0PAyaTZlpY-5cpwu_blOoWfkLyVBJ28B27I_D6tx-3Vgzv78rKbI4iw-LAvGyjVUSwTnOBAhc4Ip4hljtrCiJQHuLdnHinxb2aTN9BA==&c=8Mj1P479jvZmW-C6LCbCfXoLxxjYQzknH29BC2l56ZhwHbLWTraM9g==&ch=-tPbucq-R4A58VPk9g2-JI7cOj5xhjYSbXodic-D5Gd-kCZEoDp4Bw==)

| [WATCH NOW >>](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h1awpblQk8HOtXFvvgWNWP-2TTBr6th73S-gSKCL8bn9oGHRCawfee3ludd8WvHDoUKIKJuQn55nVlkREt5z4o_wikMZCM0rFPeHuqUAH6UfTeW5tBQUeAircKWbiDM6bE-7v5U-utQygNT0PAyaTZlpY-5cpwu_blOoWfkLyVBJ28B27I_D6tx-3Vgzv78rKbI4iw-LAvGyjVUSwTnOBAhc4Ip4hljtrCiJQHuLdnH-qO72ztKVmg==&c=8Mj1P479jvZmW-C6LCbCfXoLxxjYQzknH29BC2l56ZhwHbLWTraM9g==&ch=-tPbucq-R4A58VPk9g2-JI7cOj5xhjYSbXodic-D5Gd-kCZEoDp4Bw==)
---
For nearly 30 years, right-wing extremists ran a multi-billion dollar campaign to capture the Court. Electing Trump was the final piece of the puzzle, and we've all seen what his appointed justices on the Court have done: Roe overturned. Trump granted criminal immunity. The Voting Rights Act gutted.
The Constitution gives Congress the power to change the number of justices. It's been done seven times. No amendment is required. body:

name: Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: I will always put the people of North Carolina first.
body:
Before politics, before party and before power
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1514%2E124072%2Ejmi180)
| | | | Peter – I’ve been out on the road meeting with North Carolinians directly on the Make Stuff Cost Less tour. They tell me versions of the same thing:
---
⛽ Gas prices are spiking, and it’s costing more to put food on the table.

🩺 They can’t keep up with skyrocketing health insurance costs and get the care they need.

🇺🇲 They’re fed up with the chaos in Washington DC, and they’re worried about the future of our country.
I know we can do better. That’s why I’m in this fight.

**Before politics, before party and before power, I will always put the people of North Carolina first – as I’ve done my entire career in public service. As Governor:**
✅ I expanded Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.

✅ I added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

✅ I increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**Now, I’m ready to fight in the Senate for working families – but getting there won’t be easy. The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and I need to know that folks like you are in my corner.**
**[Will you add your name now to personally endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate? I’m looking for 5,000 signatures before midnight, and I’m hoping I can count on you. # [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2234%2E791427%2ELolTv8)
Hi,
My name is Dr. Adam Hamawy, and I’m running for Congress in New Jersey’s 12th Congressional District — the community where I was raised and where I’m raising my children today.
I’m a father, husband, humanitarian, surgeon, veteran, and small business owner who has spent my life serving others.
As a combat trauma surgeon in the U.S. Army, I treated wounded soldiers on the battlefield and later worked alongside medical teams in war zones and disaster areas, including Syria and Haiti. Over the past two years, I have traveled to Gaza twice, where I witnessed unimaginable death and destruction firsthand. Since returning, I’ve spoken out about what I saw and what our tax dollars are enabling.
I own a medical practice in the Princeton area, where I see every day how broken our healthcare system has become. Families across New Jersey are struggling to afford care, prescription drugs, and basic necessities while politicians in Washington continue to prioritize war spending over the needs of working people.
I never planned on running for Congress. But when Congresswoman Bonnie Watson-Coleman announced her retirement, I knew this was a critical moment for our district and our country. I’m stepping up to continue the fight for justice, dignity, and working families.
That’s why I’m running on a simple message: “Healthcare, Not Bombs.”
I support Medicare for All because no one should ever have to choose between paying medical bills and putting food on the table. I believe our government should invest in healthcare, housing, education, and the well-being of our communities — not endless wars abroad.
Our message is a winning message, but I need your help to get this message to voters.
**Can you chip in a split contribution between my campaign and Ilhan Omar right now to help us get there and fight for working class families?**

clean_body: Hi, My name is Dr. Adam Hamawy, and I’m running for Congress in New Jersey’s 12th Congressional District — the community where I was raised and where I’m raising my children today. I’m a father, husband, humanitarian, surgeon, veteran, and small business owner who has spent my life serving others. As a combat trauma surgeon in the U.S. Army, I treated wounded soldiers on the battlefield and later worked alongside medical teams in war zones and disaster areas, including Syria and Haiti. Over the past two years, I have traveled to Gaza twice, where I witnessed unimaginable death and destruction firsthand. Since returning, I’ve spoken out about what I saw and what our tax dollars are enabling. I own a medical practice in the Princeton area, where I see every day how broken our healthcare system has become. Families across New Jersey are struggling to afford care, prescription drugs, and basic necessities while politicians in Washington continue to prioritize war spending over the needs of working people. I never planned on running for Congress. But when Congresswoman Bonnie Watson-Coleman announced her retirement, I knew this was a critical moment for our district and our country. I’m stepping up to continue the fight for justice, dignity, and working families. That’s why I’m running on a simple message: “Healthcare, Not Bombs.” I support Medicare for All because no one should ever have to choose between paying medical bills and putting food on the table. I believe our government should invest in healthcare, housing, education, and the well-being of our communities — not endless wars abroad. Our message is a winning message, but I need your help to get this message to voters. Can you chip in a split contribution between my campaign and Ilhan Omar right now to help us get there and fight for working class families? In solidarity, Adam Hamawy PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | If you still haven't downloaded the free Simple Options Trading For Beginners guide... ...please take a few seconds and download it right now before your download link expires. As we approach this Memorial Day, we are reminded that we all celebrate the holiday differently as Americans, but we should all come together as one. This holiday was created to honor those brave men and women who have died while serving our great country.
Many Americans observe Memorial Day by visiting cemeteries or memorials, holding family barbecues, and attending parades. It has also become the unofficial kick off of the summer season.
For some though, it is also a day of grieving, as they have been directly impacted by the tragic loss of a loved one in combat.

Additionally, we should remember those soldiers that have not fallen in valor, and are still with us. As Americans we all share the same sentiment, that our veterans are a valuable commodity. These men and women should be treated with gratitude and respect. The establishment of the Department of Veterans Affairs, has allowed us as a nation to care for those soldiers who have returned from war, by providing health care and assistance.
This is important as we've learned many return with injuries, both physical and mental, including PTSD, depression, substance abuse, and anxiety. Suicide rates among our veterans are still climbing each year, says USO.org. This is a devastating issue that needs our attention. Since record keeping began after 9/11, 30,177 active duty personnel and veterans who served, have died by suicide. This is compared to the 7,057 service members killed in combat in these same 20 years. The USO and VA both agree that one main struggle for soldiers returning home is the loss of social connection. They may feel isolated and alone. We as a nation can help them by recognizing this, and including and supporting them in our local communities. After the past two years of Covid lockdowns and social isolation, it's all the more important to engage with each other in our communities.

Our company fasteatlive.com prioritizes community and connection with the creation of what we call, "live" days, built into our nutrition system. We've learned through longevity studies that a social connection is critical to our health and well-being.
As we gather together on this holiday weekend with our friends and families, let us honor our service members. We should spread love and joy. We should live to the fullest in whatever American celebration we choose to take part in. Celebrate with people by doing the things you love together. Host backyard barbecues, go boating, head to the beaches and lakes, and attend community parades. However you choose to celebrate patriots on this holiday, take a moment to remember them, and be grateful for our freedom. After all, they gave the ultimate sacrifice, so we may continue the American way of life and spirit. Freedom isn't free.

Historic Primary Day in PA-06!

The numbers don’t lie. By any standards, May 19th was an impressive day for Democratic primary elections. Up and down the ballot, we won and we won BIG!
Because of your votes, Chrissy had decisive victories in Chester and Berks Counties. Her vote total in [_**Chester County**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132110772/623423022/1440932752?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1269-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZGY1NDU1Ni0yNDU5LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AS56FqFK8svBmFcLhHhCkwLJC-jVO0huYcTJD56T3uI=&emci=9e1bf825-1b56-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=cdf54556-2459-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=21278485) was nearly double her opponent’s total (50,480 to 26,053). And in [_**Berks County**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132110773/623423027/1699162843?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1269-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZGY1NDU1Ni0yNDU5LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AS56FqFK8svBmFcLhHhCkwLJC-jVO0huYcTJD56T3uI=&emci=9e1bf825-1b56-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=cdf54556-2459-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=21278485), she garnered 12,241 votes to his 7,236 votes. And while the election has not been certified yet, we don’t expect the outcome to change.

I know for some folks it’s hard to get excited about uncontested races. Our overall voter turnout in PA-06 hovered around 20% of all registered voters. The 20% participation rate is a bit lower than usual, but given the uncontested contests and the unseasonable heat, it’s understandable. However, lower than normal turnout is not the complete story. The real story is who showed up.
Spoiler alert – the answer is you. You showed up.

You showed up in all kinds of ways. You wrote postcards and texted. You reminded your neighbors, your kids, your friends that “aren’t political” how much their vote matters. You updated your voter registration and got your mail-in ballots in with time to spare. And you showed up in person on the hottest day of the year! You put ballots in drop boxes and you got to your polling places. You did everything to make sure your voice was heard and your vote was counted. Thank you!
Chrissy could not be at home in Pennsylvania with us – her responsibility to us kept her in Washington, D.C. for committee hearings – and she knows how much work a special group of Democrats did on her behalf. You all are absolutely inspiring!
* The committee person in Kennett Square who brought her young son with her to staff the polling place table with sample ballots.
* The father and son team at Conestoga H.S. who set up their precinct’s Democratic tent at 5:45 a.m. and said that they would be there “for the duration” – otherwise known at 8 p.m. when the polls close. Did I mention it was 93 degrees and they were outside?!
* The new volunteers and the seasoned Democratic supporters who have been there and done that – working together and sharing stories.
* And the new voters! The young people who know how much of their future is on the line and who voted for the very first time in May 2026. You rock!

This is just the beginning of an election year like no other. Make no mistake, President Trump and Republicans in Congress are doing everything they can to keep their majority and to stay in power.

Absolute power corrupts absolutely. We are living the reality of this age-old maxim. From [_**weakening**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132110774/623423033/-639363259?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1269-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZGY1NDU1Ni0yNDU5LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AS56FqFK8svBmFcLhHhCkwLJC-jVO0huYcTJD56T3uI=&emci=9e1bf825-1b56-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=cdf54556-2459-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=21278485) the Voting Rights Act to the [_**abuse**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132110776/623423039/1944868225?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1269-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZGY1NDU1Ni0yNDU5LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AS56FqFK8svBmFcLhHhCkwLJC-jVO0huYcTJD56T3uI=&emci=9e1bf825-1b56-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=cdf54556-2459-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=21278485) of your taxpayer dollars to fund President Trump’s thugs of choice, there seems to be little decency in his administration.
This is no time to take our feet off the accelerator! Here’s my request to all of you – keep going! Continue to work with one another, chat with your neighbors (especially those that aren’t engaged or perhaps think differently than you), register people to vote, and make the calls and send the texts. Please take care of yourself, too. This is a long haul – find reasons to laugh, spend time with family and friends, enjoy our beautiful community, and stay hydrated.
On behalf of Chrissy, thank you so much for your continued support! If you are able to make a [_**contribution**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132110778/623423046/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1269-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZGY1NDU1Ni0yNDU5LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AS56FqFK8svBmFcLhHhCkwLJC-jVO0huYcTJD56T3uI=) to her campaign, we really appreciate it!
See you soon!
Sue Walker, Chrissy’s campaign manager

Devon, PA 19333

name: Matias, United We Dream
subject: Fear and uncertainty about the future
body:
The strength and resilience of our communities can create a future where we can all thrive. | | | Peter, Imagine graduating with dreams for your future job, home, or family, only to face fear and uncertainty instead. As thousands of immigrant youth step into adulthood this graduation season, they carry burdens that can turn their world upside down in an instant. Young immigrants are being forced to plan their futures around the possibility that everything could change overnight, threatening their hopes for stability, education, and opportunity. It's a future no one should have to bear alone. **Immigrant youth cannot wait.** In the face of these challenges, we know that the power to initiate real change rests with us — we, the people. **We know that the strength and resilience of our communities can create a future where we can all thrive regardless of our immigration status.** **[We will continue organizing to protect all immigrants, Peter. | | | | | | [A Mom, Navy Wife, Navy Veteran, Nurse Practitioner, & Congresswoman.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI2XzkyLUdHLjExMDExN190MTkwNzg5Mi0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyNl85Mi1HRy4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MDc4OTItMjA2OCJ9/1O2sR31FV4NZyeCtcvJ7EQ)

I wear these hats proudly every day, but they aren’t just titles to me. They’re the perspectives I bring with me to Washington.
* Mom & Navy Wife: protector, trying to create a better world for the next generation,
* Navy Veteran: mission-focused leader, someone who knows how to get the job done under pressure,
* Nurse Practitioner: caregiver, someone who listens first and works to heal systems that so often are broken.

I didn’t head to Washington to hear myself talk on the evening news and preach broken promises. I ran for office because I was sick and tired of the broken promises.

name: Tim Walz
subject: re: May 31
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
It’s time to put power back into the hands of our neighbors and expand the map with leaders who understand their communities.
#
Peter,
We’re facing our next end-of-month fundraising deadline on May 31, and what we raise before then will help determine how quickly we can get out on the road, support good people, and help Democrats compete in places too many politicians have written off.
[**I’ll say more about why that matters in a moment. But first, I’m going to get right to it: Can you make a contribution of $5 or whatever makes sense for you to help us hit our goal?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260526-1.Ts1NSZ&amount=5&refcode=em20260526-687&t=1&akid=687%2E34582%2EosAjHm)
I grew up in the kind of town where everybody knew everybody. Everybody’s kids played together. Everybody helped when someone was in trouble.
We gathered together as neighbors after football games and graduations, and more often than not, those gatherings took place at our public school.
My public school was foundational. It was more than my education and more than the name on a jersey. It was where our town came together — to cheer on our kids, celebrate milestones, support each other through hard times, and remember that we belonged to something bigger than ourselves.
_Heck, in a lot of ways, the school was the town._
And that wasn’t the only place that held the community together. It was the grocery store where you ran into half your neighbors. The clinic where families knew the nurses by name. The main street businesses that sponsored the Little League team. The job with a decent wage that let folks build a life close to the people they loved.
Those are the kinds of cornerstones every community deserves. But nowadays, too many of them are starting to crumble.
The local school gets underfunded. The local grocery store? Gone. The local clinic? Gone. The job with a decent wage? Harder and harder to find.
We’re losing our neighbors. We’re losing our communities. And we are not talking to each other enough anymore. That is what it looks like to defund and divide America.
Republicans like Donald Trump and JD Vance want working people to believe the problem is their neighbor. But that couldn’t be further from the truth. The problem is the tech bros, venture capitalists, and robber barons who are ripping communities apart while they get richer and take more power for themselves.
**I launched Small Town PAC to fight back, because it’s long past time to put power back into the hands of our neighbors and help Democrats expand the map with leaders who actually understand the places they want to represent.**
I’m ready to pass the baton and get out on the road to find teachers, nurses, veterans, laborers, young people, and local voices who can represent their communities better than Silicon Valley and billionaire-backed politicians.
Lord knows Democrats need some new faces. So let’s recruit good people with fresh energy and bold ideas who are willing to fight for the places that raised them.
But the size and speed of that work depends on what we can raise at the grassroots level — people chipping in dollar by dollar, investing in the future we believe in and know is possible.
[**So before our May 31 deadline, I’m asking you to step up: Please make a contribution of $5 or whatever you can afford to Small Town PAC today so we can get out on the road, support the next generation of Democratic leaders, and compete in the places Democrats need to win.**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260526-1.Ts1NSZ&amount=5&refcode=em20260526-687&t=2&akid=687%2E34582%2EosAjHm)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260526-1.Ts1NSZ&amount=5&refcode=20260526-687&t=21&akid=687%2E34582%2EosAjHm)**
Let’s start talking to each other again about the issues that actually impact us. Let’s take the fight to the venture capitalists and robber barons who are ripping our communities apart. And let’s go win some elections.
I’m grateful,
Tim Walz

Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.
**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260526-687&t=22&refcode2=687_34582_osAjHm&akid=687%2E34582%2EosAjHm)**
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260526-687-&t=23&refcode2=687_34582_osAjHm&akid=687%2E34582%2EosAjHm)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.

# Brent Crude rises 2% on Iran strikes
Brent crude oil futures climbed 2 percent to $98.26 a barrel Tuesday as U.S. self-defense military strikes in southern Iran and President Trump's mixed signals on peace talks with Tehran **[kept traders on edge.](https://substack.com/redirect/a981f089-913f-4184-b95a-199bef8bb5a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a981f089-913f-4184-b95a-199bef8bb5a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**US Military Conducts Strikes:** Forces targeted vessels deploying mines and missile locations in southern Iran to protect troops from Iranian threats.
**Trump Comments Mixed Signals:** The president encouraged several nations to join the Abraham Accords while noting Iran negotiations proceed nicely but warned of resumed action if talks fail.
**Global Inventories Decline Sharply:** UBS reported oil market remains strongly undersupplied with sharp inventory drops and potential production losses exceeding 1 billion barrels by May end.
**WTI Futures Trade Lower:** July West Texas Intermediate contracts fell 5.1 percent at $91.73 compared to Friday's close amid the Memorial Day holiday.

# BP ousts Chairman over conduct issues
BP's board unanimously removed Chairman Albert Manifold with immediate effect **[over serious governance, oversight and conduct concerns,](https://substack.com/redirect/052eb84e-0ce0-45f9-8f50-fbb2d042edf6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** sending London-listed shares down as much as 9 percent.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/052eb84e-0ce0-45f9-8f50-fbb2d042edf6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Board Takes Decisive Action:** Directors cited unacceptable issues and expressed surprise and disappointment at the governance problems discovered shortly after Manifold took the post in October.
**Shares Plunge On News:** The energy major's stock fell sharply before partially recovering following the surprise leadership announcement.
**Interim Chair Appointed Quickly:** Ian Tyler steps in immediately while a succession process for a permanent chairman begins.
**Recent Shareholder Support Lower:** Manifold who took on the role in October notably received lower backing at the annual general meeting amid a prior investor rebellion.

* * *
* * *
# Wells Fargo backs 3D printed homes
Wells Fargo **[will now write mortgages on Icon 3D-printed homes](https://substack.com/redirect/8fe17d20-7ed0-4f58-a582-ac615b888195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and provide buyers a 50 basis point lender credit incentive as the bank partners with the leading 3D construction firm to boost housing affordability.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8fe17d20-7ed0-4f58-a582-ac615b888195?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Lender Credit Offered Buyers:** Wells Fargo gives 50 basis point discount to purchasers of Icon 3D-printed homes financed through its mortgage products.
**Preferred Lender Partnership Formed:** Icon names Wells Fargo its preferred lender after years of foundation work on 3D printed communities for people without housing.
**Past Financing Hurdles Eased:** Traditional lenders previously hesitated to get into the 3D printed housing space due to concerns over technological viability, value appreciation and ability to sell or insure the loans.
**Titan Printers Now Available:** Icon sells new multistory-capable 3D printers priced at $899,000 with Wells Fargo financing options for builders and developers.
* * *
* * *
# Krispy Kreme pays $1.6M data breach settlement
Krispy Kreme **[will pay $1.6 million to settle a class-action lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/1678b85c-0109-4101-9562-9baab991e5e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over a November 2024 data breach that exposed sensitive customer details including names, birth dates, Social Security numbers and financial account information.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1678b85c-0109-4101-9562-9baab991e5e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Affected US Residents Qualify:** Individuals in the United States who received notice of the data incident form the eligible settlement class.
**Maximum Payout Requires Evidence:** Claimants who document fraud or identity theft losses tied to the breach can receive as much as $3,500 while others get $75.
**Filing Deadline Approaches Soon:** All forms must be submitted online or postmarked no later than June 22, 2026 to meet the cutoff.
**Company Denies Any Wrongdoing:** Krispy Kreme settled the case without admitting liability and joins other recent corporate payouts for data incidents.

Hey folks,
**Katie Phang** joined me for another episode of _Breaking Bread_ and honestly, this one covered everything. We talked about Memorial Day, family, Hamilton, democracy, war, Trump, disappearing members of Congress, and what it feels like to try to stay human while the internet wants all of us to become avatars screaming at each other 24/7.
There were moments that got deeply personal. There were moments that got fiery. And there were moments where both of us were just trying to process how completely upside down this country feels right now.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:13**] Mike and Katie kick things off by talking Memorial Day weekend, burnout, family time, and why it feels impossible to disconnect from the political machine anymore.
* [**00:04:30**] Katie shares an emotional story about taking her daughter and mother to see _Hamilton_ in New York -- and how the audience reaction turned into a powerful reminder about democracy and resistance.
* [**00:16:49**] The conversation turns to Iran, Trump's chaotic messaging on war, and the terrifying reality that Congress feels completely absent while major military decisions are happening in real time.
* [**00:23:00**] Mike and Katie debate Republicans like Tom Massie, the Epstein files coalition, and whether any kind of anti-MAGA bipartisan alliance is actually possible in this political environment.
* [**00:42:10**] They close out by ripping into the performative outrage machine in American politics, laughing about George W. Bush's "nuclear strategery," and reflecting on why authenticity matters more than ever.

This episode is really about something bigger than politics. It's about exhaustion. It's about trying to hold onto your values while everything around you feels engineered to make people angrier, more isolated, and less human. We talked war, propaganda, power, media, and the Democratic Party's identity crisis -- but underneath all of it was a conversation about how we keep showing up for each other anyway.
If you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.

--Mike

## The Left's Stephen Colbert Meltdown Is About More Than Comedy
You'd think Stephen Colbert had cured cancer.
The reaction to CBS ending _The Late Show with Stephen Colbert_ has been extraordinary: media figures mourning, politicians outraged, commentators warning of threats to democracy, and the usual crowd acting as though an American institution has been destroyed.
And then Trump makes a joke, about the guy who makes jokes about him everyday, and MORE outrage.
[| | | | | Donald J. Trump

Give me a break.
For years, conservatives watched their own voices removed from platforms, sidelined from networks, demonetized, or outright canceled -- and the same people now demanding outrage were nowhere to be found.
Where was the national grieving period when conservatives get silenced, seemingly weekly?
Where were the think pieces about free speech? The emotional monologues? The warnings about political suppression?
Silence.
What's remarkable about the reaction isn't Colbert leaving television -- it's the double standard.

body:
It’s Election Day in the Texas primary runoff.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
**Today is the Texas primary runoff, and voters across the state are heading to the polls to decide critical races, from U.S. Senate to attorney general to county offices and everything in between.**
I believe our right to vote is sacred. It determines who represents us, what laws get passed, and what kind of Texas our kids and grandkids inherit.
And I want to say this clearly today — voters are already working to shape the kind of Texas they want for future generations.
In recent elections, Texans flipped a deep red state Senate seat, flipped school boards, city council seats, and mayors’ offices across the state — and all of these are places where Democrats haven’t seen wins at all or in a very long time.
It’s happening because Texans are fed up with corruption and leaders who serve donors first and families second.
Now we have an opportunity to carry that momentum all the way to November. We’re building a movement that can turn frustration into real change statewide. The fight ahead is uphill, but it is absolutely winnable if we all do our part any way we can.
**[Can I count on you to chip in $5 today to help turn this momentum into a victory in November?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260526_1_eday.yXphe4&refcode=em20260526-1194&amount=5&t=1&akid=1194%2E299639%2Et7zo4t)**

# This map is a Menace.
---
|
---
| |
| | | | | | **Last week I testified at the Senate hearing on redistricting about the proposed map splitting the City of Spartanburg in half.**[**You can see my full testimony here**](https://us.list-manage.com/H1P0DUCIrGc?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)**, and read my remarks below.**
---
| My name is Kathryn Harvey. I serve as the chair of the Spartanburg County Democratic Party- but today I’m here as a concerned resident of the city of Spartanburg.
This Bill would cut my city and county into two Congressional Districts - moving the entire Eastside of Spartanburg, Pacolet, Cowpens into Congressional District 5. We will share a Congressional District with Rock Hill instead of our neighboring county of Greenville.
This map would split city council representation, county council representation, our District 7 schools, and several precincts into two congressional districts.
It would also draw 700 people out of the town of Lyman, just one precinct would have a different congressional representative than the other 8,000 residents. And instead of driving to a Congressional field office 15 min away in Greer they will have to drive 90 minutes to Rock Hill.
As someone who led our countywide 2020 Census efforts in Spartanburg and ran as the Democratic Nominee for Congress in 2024, I can tell you that this is sheer insanity. And I will remind you that 2020 was an undercount and our population has boomed.
The city of Spartanburg has an estimated population of about 40,000 residents, while the broader Spartanburg County area is home to nearly 400,000
By 2030 we'll be well on our way to half a million.
At a time when we as a community are bringing more business in than nearly any other county in the state, when nearly 30 people move to our county every day, when we have generational investment in education which receives federal funding, and when our community is finally getting our dues...you're going to divide us.
And as far as political power and representation: I can also tell you that the likelihood anyone like Liz Patterson or Trey Gowdy who were Congressional representatives from Spartanburg ever serving again in this new district is very low. It will dilute our political power in every way shape and form.
But what I’m most concerned about is the confusion it will cause for voters. I’ve spent nearly a decade working locally to inform, educate, and turn out voters and I can ensure you this will not only dilute trust in government which is at an all time low, but also put undue stress on an already taxed election system.
People get confused when their polling place moves, now their whole congressional district is going to move on top of it.
Voters should choose their elected officials. Elected officials should not choose their voters.
And finally I’ll leave you with this:
Every single one of you has been a candidate and a voter. I want you to go home tonight and try to put yourself in the shoes of the current candidates and voters you'll disenfranchise and ask yourself if you'd want this done to you.
This map truly is a menace.

Thank you to Billy Webster who hosted our Democratic Women for an invigorating evening as we rallied around our state house warriors fighting mid-decade redistricting and celebrated candidates running in 2026.
And on Sunday night we took a break and went to a winning Spartanburgers Game celebrating the 250th Anniversary of the Revolutionary War.
Democracy is a participatory sport y’all, stay with me!

I serve as the chair of the Spartanburg County Democratic Party- but today I’m here as a concerned resident of the city of Spartanburg. This Bill would cut my city and county into two Congressional Districts - moving the entire Eastside of Spartanburg, Pacolet, Cowpens into Congressional District 5. We will share a Congressional District with Rock Hill instead of our neighboring county of Greenville. This map would split city council representation, county council representation, our District 7 schools, and several precincts into two congressional districts. It would also draw 700 people out of the town of Lyman, just one precinct would have a different congressional representative than the other 8,000 residents. And instead of driving to a Congressional field office 15 min away in Greer they will have to drive 90 minutes to Rock Hill. As someone who led our countywide 2020 Census efforts in Spartanburg and ran as the Democratic Nominee for Congress in 2024, I can tell you that this is sheer insanity. And I will remind you that 2020 was an undercount and our population has boomed. The city of Spartanburg has an estimated population of about 40,000 residents, while the broader Spartanburg County area is home to nearly 400,000 By 2030 we'll be well on our way to half a million. At a time when we as a community are bringing more business in than nearly any other county in the state, when nearly 30 people move to our county every day, when we have generational investment in education which receives federal funding, and when our community is finally getting our dues...you're going to divide us. And as far as political power and representation: I can also tell you that the likelihood anyone like Liz Patterson or Trey Gowdy who were Congressional representatives from Spartanburg ever serving again in this new district is very low. It will dilute our political power in every way shape and form. But what I’m most concerned about is the confusion it will cause for voters. I’ve spent nearly a decade working locally to inform, educate, and turn out voters and I can ensure you this will not only dilute trust in government which is at an all time low, but also put undue stress on an already taxed election system. People get confused when their polling place moves, now their whole congressional district is going to move on top of it. Voters should choose their elected officials. Elected officials should not choose their voters. And finally I’ll leave you with this: Every single one of you has been a candidate and a voter. Friends, As we wrap up May, I want to sincerely thank everyone who helped collect nomination signatures for our campaign. Your time, effort, and support are helping build a true grassroots movement across Wisconsin’s 5th Congressional District. Our nomination papers will be hand delivered to Madison on Friday, May 28. If you still have any completed nomination sheets to turn in, please reach out to me as soon as possible at andy.beck@beckforcongress.com. This past week, I attended an incredibly uplifting event in Watertown where local high school students were finally able to perform Omar Thomas’ “A Mother of a Revolution!” after the piece had been cancelled at the last minute by the school board because of its LGBTQ+ theme. Ironically, this is an entirely acoustic musical piece, and most people would never have known the background of the composition had it not been banned. Instead of division winning, the community responded with compassion and overwhelming support. Hundreds gathered to support these students, their music, and the idea that art and education should bring people together, not push people apart. It was a genuinely hopeful moment and a reminder that kindness and community still matter deeply in Wisconsin. Now we move into the next phase of the campaign as we head toward the November General Election. Over the coming months, our focus will be on reaching voters throughout the 5th Congressional District, building name recognition, and growing this movement community by community. This is a grassroots campaign, and every conversation helps. Please continue helping by: • Telling your friends and neighbors about the campaign • Putting up a lawn sign • Following and sharing our social media pages • Volunteering or spreading the word whenever you can • Donating and asking others to donate to the campaign Together, we can build a campaign focused on lowering costs, creating good jobs, and improving healthcare for working families across Wisconsin’s 5th District. Thank you again for your support. Andy

name: Jim Clyburn
subject: Jim Crow 2.0
body:
South Carolina Republicans are trying to pass a dangerous new map.
Under pressure from Donald Trump, South Carolina House Republicans just rushed through a dangerous new congressional map -- **and they’re hoping to get full passage by Tuesday, May 26.**
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260526-1.9C2IF3&refcode=em20260526-1425&%3Bamount=5&t=1&akid=1425%2E1086043%2En1Bprz)
**I’m concerned. The new congressional map would eliminate South Carolina’s 6th District -- the only Democratic district in the state -- while early voting is already underway.**
**[Republicans aren’t wasting any time, and neither can we Peter. If you believe in fair representation, in voting rights, and in a democracy that works for everyone, I’m asking you to stand with me today. Please rush in a contribution to help me fight back.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260526-1.9C2IF3&refcode=em-20260526-1&t=2&akid=1425%2E1086043%2En1Bprz)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260526-1.9C2IF3&amount=5&refcode=em-20260526-1&t=21&akid=1425%2E1086043%2En1Bprz)**
Republicans are breaking apart South Carolina’s 6th District. Not because voters demanded it, but because Donald Trump requested it.
This fight is bigger than one district. It’s about whether our democracy belongs to the people, or to politicians who change the rules when they don’t like the results.
**We cannot let them succeed.**
** If we stand together right now with a massive show of force, we can make their plan backfire. _Please donate today to help me fight back against this dangerous attack on our democracy._**
Thank you,
Jim
[Donate](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/412?c0=wes-em-20260526-1.nbzdAq&refcode=em-20260526-1-el&t=22&akid=1425%2E1086043%2En1Bprz)
---
P.S. I grew up in the Jim Crow South. When I was a boy in South Carolina, fewer than 1% of Black residents could vote.
I know what it looks like when a government tries to silence voices and deny people their most basic rights. And it’s happening right now in South Carolina.
**[I’m humbly asking you to make a contribution of any amount to help us mobilize and protect the only Democratic district in the state._](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260526-1.9C2IF3&refcode=em-20260526-1&t=23&akid=1425%2E1086043%2En1Bprz)**

A humbling message...
| Patriot,
---
I’m truly humbled and honored.
---
Direct from the White House, my friend President Trump said:
---
**“JIM JORDAN IS A VERY GOOD FRIEND, FIGHTER, AND WINNER... HE WILL _NEVER_ LET YOU DOWN”**

Coming from the President, those are powerful words.
---
President Trump knows _better than anyone_ the fight I’m waging to drain the swamp and put power back where it belongs – with _YOU_ , the American people.
---
Look, I know talk is cheap in politics. Anyone can make a promise. Anyone can say they’ll fight.
---
**But I’ve got the receipts to back it up**. I’ve been sued. I’ve been spied on. My phone records were seized. And the Left only attacks me, because I fight for YOU.
---
**I’m working with the President – _behind the scenes and all hours of the day_ – to deliver on the agenda you voted for.**
---
And directly from the Oval Office, President Trump laid out the agenda **WE** are fighting for:
---
_**✅Grow our economy
✅Cut taxes
✅Slash burdensome regulations
✅Promote Made-In-The-USA products
✅Champion American energy dominance
✅Keep our border secure
✅Stop migrant crime
✅Defend your constitutional rights
✅Stopping the Radical Left ** _
---
And in just a few months, that same agenda will be voted on AGAIN in the midterm elections.
---
There’s been a lot of doom and gloom about our odds of holding the House. But truth be told, Democrats now ONLY have a **2-POINT** advantage over us.
---
And that’s not because voters suddenly approve of Radical Left ideas._It’s simply because our side isn’t showing up to vote._
---
**If 2% more Republicans show up, we can EASILY erase the Democrats’ 2-point lead. This is a problem we can absolutely fix.**
---
_So, we are going zip code by zip code in our voter file to determine where we need more participation._
---
Patriot, we’ve crunched the numbers and with our razor-thin majority now within the margin of error, YOUR voter profile in your zip code is the difference maker.
---
_That’s why I’m reaching out today to simply ask that you VERIFY your GOP voter profile to give me and President Trump the most accurate polling possible to ERASE the Democrats’ 2% LEAD over us._

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, we are
officially one week away from the Democratic primary elections in New
Jersey and California — and we have the chance to send FOUR more Justice
Democrats to Congress.

But corporate Democrats, AIPAC, billionaire dollars, and establishment
super PACs are spending heavily to stop them.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260526-1.OhcVxG&refcode=em20260526-37821&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37821%2E1203867%2E-nNWMb ]If you’re already with us, can you rush $5 or more right
now to get our candidates in NJ and CA over the finish line?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260526-1.OhcVxG&refcode=em20260526-37821&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37821%2E1203867%2E-nNWMb ]Contribute $5

In New Jersey, Dr. Adam Hamawy is taking on the political establishment in
NJ-12 with a campaign rooted in healthcare justice, ending forever wars,
and fighting for working people over corporate interests.

And in California, three more bold progressives are running against deeply
entrenched establishment power backed by AIPAC and the AI lobby:

* Mai Vang in CA-07, a Sacramento City Councilmember and daughter of
Hmong refugees who is taking on a nearly 50-year Matsui political
dynasty with a campaign focused on working families and community
investment;
* Angela Gonzales-Torres in CA-34, a working-class Angeleno and
community advocate who is challenging incumbent Jimmy Gomez with a
movement centered on affordable housing, public safety, and economic
justice;
* And Saikat Chakrabarti in CA-11, a former Bernie Sanders organizer and
co-founder of Justice Democrats, who is running to succeed Nancy
Pelosi with a bold vision for climate action, holding Big Tech
accountable, and ending corruption in politics.

Every single one of these candidates is rejecting corporate PAC money and
focused on building grassroots power — and they’re exactly what the
establishment is afraid of.

While their opponents have corporate PACs, AIPAC, and party insiders
lining up behind them — our candidates have YOU.

These races are about more than just four seats in Congress. They’re about
whether the Democratic Party will continue protecting a broken status quo
— or become a party that will actually fight for working people.

Right now, too many establishment Democrats offer the same old talking
points and fail to act, while families struggle with impossible rents,
unaffordable healthcare, stagnant wages, and the consequences of endless
war.

Our Justice Democrats are running to change that.

But with just one week left until these primaries, we need the resources
to fight back against the flood of attacks and outside spending pouring
into these races.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260526-1.OhcVxG&refcode=em20260526-37821&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=37821%2E1203867%2E-nNWMb ]So please, Peter,
chip in whatever you can today to help
elect FOUR more Justice Democrats and transform the party as we know it.
Every dollar in this final stretch matters.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260526-1.OhcVxG&refcode=em20260526-37821&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=37821%2E1203867%2E-nNWMb ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: I was not popular with some of my fellow Representatives.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
When I got to Washington, I was not popular with some of my fellow Representatives.
I had just unseated a very popular guy in Washington — and at my first caucus meeting during orientation, he was still presiding over the room. Everyone knew him. I was new. I didn't know anyone.
Then a congressman leaned over to me and said: **"Man, it's such a shame that girl beat him."**
I looked back at him. I said: **"You mean me?"**
The blood drained from his face. It was chilly. And not just because I beat their friend — **it was because I challenged the power structure that existed then and still exists now.**
I’ve never campaigned like the establishment says you’re supposed to. I don’t spend my days calling donors like most members of Congress.

clean_body: When I got to Washington, I was not popular with some of my fellow Representatives. I had just unseated a very popular guy in Washington — and at my first caucus meeting during orientation, he was still presiding over the room. Everyone knew him. I was new. I didn't know anyone. Then a congressman leaned over to me and said: "Man, it's such a shame that girl beat him." I looked back at him. I said: "You mean me?" The blood drained from his face. It was chilly. And not just because I beat their friend — it was because I challenged the power structure that existed then and still exists now. I’ve never campaigned like the establishment says you’re supposed to. I don’t spend my days calling donors like most members of Congress. We’re going to continue creating a new way to do politics rooted in community organizing and building a movement of working-class voices that went unheard for far too long. name: Major General Paul Eaton, U.S. Army, retired
subject: An open letter to the leadership of the Democratic Party
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
Memorial Day is above politics. Period. We expect better. We are better. And as one of the largest organizations in Democratic politics, we demand better from the party we work night and day to support.
#
Peter, this is Paul Eaton.
Yesterday, Memorial Day, the official account of the Democratic Party posted about the men and women we’ve lost since Donald Trump attacked Iran.
On its face, I can understand why some might think it an appropriate thing to do. This is a war that never should’ve begun, it was started by Donald Trump, and American Troops are dead because of his leadership. On any other day, that is a pointed and accurate criticism.
Not on Memorial Day. There are precious few days where America can put aside politics and focus on what truly matters — our friends, our loved ones, the lives we enjoy, and the people who died to give us that opportunity. Memorial Day is one of them. It’s as sacred a time as any to the people who have worn our nation’s uniform and their families.
It doesn’t matter that Donald Trump has torn up any shred of decorum, that he has no honor, that he insults the fallen, tramples their graves, and attacks their families. It doesn’t matter that he violated the sanctity of Memorial Day himself yesterday, or that the Republican Party bends to Trump’s every word and will never hold him accountable.
Memorial Day is above politics. Period. We expect better. We are better. And as one of the largest organizations in Democratic politics, we demand better from the party we work night and day to support. If we do not demand this of our own, we cannot credibly demand it of our opponents.
I can’t think of a better example why the leadership VoteVets provides within our party is so critically important than this. It gets to the very core of our purpose as an organization: Democrats need to listen to Veterans if they’re going to win their votes.
If we are going to retake Congress this November, it’s time for the Democratic Party and their leadership to shape up.
Too much is at stake for any less.
Thank you for your time,
Paul Eaton
Major General, U.S. Army, Retired
Senior Advisor, VoteVets

body:
| Donald Trump has cooked up a new scheme, and it might be one of his most brazen acts of self-dealing yet.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9817%2E5257348%2Es9h-z_)
Derek, Donald Trump has cooked up a new scheme, and it might be one of his most brazen acts of self-dealing yet. He's calling it the "Anti-Weaponization Fund." I'm calling it what it is: a $1.776 billion taxpayer-funded slush fund to pay off election deniers, cop beaters and cronies. The fund will be controlled by his hand-picked attorney general (and former criminal defense lawyer), who will pay it out to so-called "victims of weaponization" — with no review by a judge or Congress. First, Trump filed a bogus claim against the federal government. Then, he directed his Attorney General to settle the case. And now, he wants to profit off of taxpayer dollars. It is grotesque. It is the worst form of self-dealing and self-enrichment we have ever seen from a sitting president. And Derek, I'm not going to let it happen quietly. That's why I'm introducing two bills in the Senate: **The first bill effectively bans Trump's Anti-Weaponization slush fund** — shutting down a spending program the president invented out of thin air, without a single vote from Congress. **The second bill blocks any payment from this fund to Donald Trump, JD Vance, members of Congress, congressional staff, or any other employee of the Trump administration or campaign** — because taxpayer dollars should never be used to enrich the very people running the government. We have the power in Congress to stop this. It's time we used it. Republicans are already getting nervous about this one — even some of them are calling it a slush fund. They punted votes last week to avoid having to anger Trump on this very issue. But being nervous isn't enough. We need to force the vote, put every senator on the record, and stop this before a single dollar goes out the door. [**To do that, I need to show that this fight has real grassroots strength behind it. Will you chip in $10 or whatever you can to help me lead the charge to block Trump's slush fund?**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q22026_abs_em.dQeZoR&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260526_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=9817%2E5257348%2Es9h-z_) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [EXPRESS DONATE $10](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2142?c0=q22026_abs_em.nSz-K7&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20260526_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=5&akid=9817%2E5257348%2Es9h-z_)

California Democrats,
Election Day is just ONE WEEK away! It's more critical now than ever that we stay in the fight to flip seats, take back the House, and protect our democracy. Join California Democrats across the state to call voters, knock on doors, and ensure every voter has a plan to turn in their ballot by June 2! [https://linktr.ee/cadem]
P.S. If you were forwarded this newsletter and want to receive them in your inbox going forward, click here [http://www.cadem.org] and scroll to the bottom of the page to sign up!

Last week, we held a Voter Protection Training centered around what we're doing to protect the vote, California's election security standards and voter protection laws, and important voter resources. If you missed it, check out the resources below:
* Check out our Voter Resource toolkit, [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mUnqpl_m-6j-DvvYhTTSWIeu-hyK9J4cMVkrN16l73o/edit?tab=t.0] which includes multilingual information on how to vote, voter rights, important voting deadlines and more.
* Check out [https://cadem.org/our-endorsements/] CADEM's online endorsement tool [https://cadem.org/our-endorsements/] [https://cadem.org/our-endorsements/] to find endorsed Democrats where you live.
* Visit our [https://cadem.org/vote/] Voter Information page [https://cadem.org/vote/] [https://cadem.org/vote/] to find all the resources you need to turn in your ballot and remind friends and family to do the same.
* Make a plan to vote by June 2: [https://caearlyvoting.sos.ca.gov/] Drop your ballot in an official drop-box [https://caearlyvoting.sos.ca.gov/] , vote in-person at a vote center or polling place [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/polling-place] , or return your ballot by mail TODAY [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/voter-registration/vote-mail] (to ensure it's postmarked by Election Day - no stamp required!).
https://linktr.ee/cadem [https://linktr.ee/cadem]
On Saturday, May 16, Democrats across the state came together for our Statewide Day of Action. Together, we hosted 36 canvasses and 2 phonebanks across 21 counties, where volunteers had hundreds of meaningful conversations with voters about what's at stake in this election. It's not too late to join the fight forward, help us get out the vote in these last 7 days [https://linktr.ee/cadem] before Election Day and be the reason someone decides to vote.
This past week, we had our second Spanish language phonebank [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/947093/] of the year! Led by our California Latino Coalition, volunteers are calling Spanish-speaking voters every Tuesday from 5:30-7:30PM in target Congressional districts to talk about the issues they care about and encourage them to make a plan to vote. Yes. It's true. We could go from Gavin Newsom to a Republican in charge of the nation's largest state. That is why my team and I made a difficult decision you need to know about. One that puts us at risk, but one we had to do. **A little over a week ago, a new poll was released showing my Republican opponent, Steve Hilton, passing me in the polls by one point. Not great with early voting underway.** So we decided to ramp up our digital outreach to persuade new California voters and show them that our campaign is going to fight for them, stand up to Trump, and defend the California Dream. **The good news is,_it worked._ A new Emerson College poll released days later put us back in the lead.** The bad news is, we devoted a huge amount of money to expanding our digital outreach and the money wasn’t in the budget. It was a risky decision, but one we had to take because we can’t afford to fall behind in this race and risk a Republican lock-out. **So now, I am coming to you for help to make up the budget gap.** Because I cannot do it alone. body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240865%2E444211%2EEerHTc)
I want you to meet Carla, our star volunteer in Tyler.
Carla has been holding down the fort for us in Northeast Texas, proving every single day that our movement is growing all over the state, not just in the big cities. In places that don't always get the same attention or resources as Austin, Dallas, or Houston, it’s dedicated leaders like Carla who are going to make the difference for us this November.
Without a staff organizer in her region, Carla is the organization. Every single week she sets up at Tyler Junior College to meet, register, and stay in touch with voters. But she doesn’t stop there. Carla is a force multiplier: she’s coaching and lifting up other local volunteers, like Maria, to build a powerful team, and she’s already brainstorming how to recruit interns to expand our footprint to UT Tyler this fall.
What makes Carla truly special is her touch. She customizes her outreach to every single voter she interacts with, ensuring they feel seen, heard, and valued. Whether she’s organizing at local Pride events in Longview and Tyler or calling through lists of local volunteers to get them involved, she brings a personal connection that you just can't replicate from afar.
When I called Carla recently to thank her, she told me, "I'll hold up my end of the bargain." She absolutely is. Now, we need to hold up ours by giving her the resources she needs to keep expanding.
[**Please pitch in today to support Carla and ensure we can empower grassroots leaders in every corner of Texas.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260526.6FnCWs&refcode=ema20260526-240865&t=3&akid=240865%2E444211%2EEerHTc)
Thank you for being in this fight with us,
Aimee

Nearly two million Texans turned out in the Republican Primary for Attorney General—and despite being massively outspent and targeted by the political establishment and their wealthy backers, we forced this race into a runoff. My opponent poured more than $16 million of his own money into this race, only to finish at 39%. Meanwhile, we were hit by a California-based, left-wing PAC angry that I stood with Donald Trump to strip out hundreds of billions in Green New Deal-style subsidies from the so-called "Big Beautiful Bill." But let's be honest about what's at stake. This is no time to hand the Attorney General's office to someone who's never set foot in a courtroom. Texas is facing serious challenges: a wide-open border, foreign adversaries buying up our land, and a radical agenda determined to reshape our state and our country. We need a proven conservative who knows how to fight - and win. The Attorney General isn't a ceremonial role. It's the chief legal officer of the largest conservative state in America. It requires leadership from day one—building a strong legal team, enforcing the law without hesitation, and taking the fight wherever it's needed to defend Texas. I'm ready to do that. But I need to know if conservatives like you are in this fight with me. I've been working around the clock to make sure Texans understand exactly what's on the line in this runoff. Let's finish this. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Date: May 26, 2026 Contact: william@jonbonck.com
JON BONCK WINS TX-38 REPUBLICAN NOMINATION HOUSTON, TEXAS -- Tonight, Republican voters across Texas' 38th Congressional District delivered a decisive victory to businessman, Christian conservative, and political outsider Jon Bonck.
Bonck thanked supporters, volunteers, and voters for building a grassroots movement centered on faith, family, freedom, and preserving the American Dream for the next generation.
"Tonight, the people of TX-38 made it clear that they are ready for a conservative outsider who will fight for our families, our faith, and our future," said Bonck. "This campaign was built by hardworking Texans who believe our country is worth fighting for and that the American Dream should still be achievable for the next generation."
Throughout the campaign, Bonck focused on border security, lowering costs for families, defending Christian conservative values, and putting America and Texans first.
"Texans didn't judge us by headlines, attacks, or political noise," Bonck continued during his victory remarks. "They judged us by our work. By the thousands of doors we knocked, the calls we made, the grassroots movement we built, and the people who stood with us. They judged us by our faith, our consistency, and our willingness to fight for the values that matter. Tonight's victory belongs to every volunteer, every supporter, and every voter who believed our country is still worth fighting for."
A proud Houstonian, Jon alongside his wife Laura, have built multiple successful real estate businesses, helping more than 1,000 Texas families achieve the American dream of homeownership while remaining deeply involved in their community and church.
"This victory belongs to the people of TX-38," Bonck said. "Now we turn our focus toward November and the fight to secure our border, defend our freedoms, protect our communities, and preserve the America we love for our children and grandchildren."
Bonck also thanked President Donald Trump, Senator Ted Cruz, Harris County Commissioner Tom Ramsey, conservative grassroots leaders, and the thousands of volunteers and supporters who fueled the campaign's momentum throughout the runoff election.
###
