clean_body: Hi there, I wanted to reach out because something pretty huge happened recently, and I wanted to make sure you heard about it. If you haven’t been watching the news, last month the US Supreme Court handed down a devastating ruling in Louisiana v. Callais. They basically gutted Section 2 of the 1965 Voting Rights Act. If you remember your history, that landmark law was put in place to stop states from diluting the votes of minorities — especially Black voters who had been systematically disenfranchised for generations. Section 2 was our shield against that kind of discrimination. But now? The Supreme Court basically said that as long as politicians claim they’re just playing "party politics," dismantling people’s voting power is totally fine. It’s infuriating, and as Justice Elena Kagan wrote in her dissent, it renders this crucial federal law "all but a dead letter." Washington is actively rolling back civil rights. But I promise you, we are not sitting back in Michigan. We’ve become the first state in the entire country since that awful ruling to hold a legislative hearing on state-level protections to enshrine those exact voting rights. I’m incredibly proud to have co-sponsored these bills and voted them right out of the Elections Committee to build a state-level shield. Our bills will restore those anti-discrimination protections on the state level, expand language access for voters, and force real local transparency. Because at the end of the day, democracy only works if everyone has an equal say. The Constitution is clear: states run elections. When federal protections falter, it is up to us to lead the way and show the rest of the country how it's done. For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics.

| | | | | |

[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=1bb695f7558e4e0d8c483841511f9921&_e=OmGzZRHhZbBlAJKzVfg87n4WEfxVFF1bixcVOONk-lfRx9OlPnLR4bmZngRw5iWfg1Um2gKBzhRK5fc8YQ5h9TJEL8hF0Fu256bEfo_4bnRBGlpcf9TLKWkDO-Pk6mYBHv8LbrzEIPKCfeFT75hYEeTyum8WPPt3s3A3EiTG2D_9fbEHBsNOKrsHVezJxtkOK3r7E5jaL4hweqNgm7lLTvKX5btb8sGvrAeHTdTgVp3ZWDARxwualheAq1GDltkCV1OVuCNsmhNowTWWlXdT3e17sTvQQB-Ek29ikTyMSiJzlTsfAnaUP0lhpA7Lv4iYha1oVs3ZqGSlxJ-1f0vpLlTPNWlEyTe87Ys6Mi2wFRGKi-cDznIjEp-hEryRcUCt-WiSOwolf19JZisQWbr1ou2XH2yoYr5bU172XRx_6WJfhnMK3jkS63Fl272CyAFSezycysWE96Fc9BHFMNr7Kl0V-WW3mN8aboyXSLnsznzqBuLSZqkK8Cr7t-daMuL7S-1qS5BLaT20c7MF-_HnKFq0tj1KyZBeBtcofn7JB8CeixfzYS3IyFjzYGd3JPSr2CXk4Qdb-St8FJ34x8PISB3ahVJm3p7_dq1iluHD7DBNlyuBcxg9JiVYkORbtAQdgWml-unAr3LQ4pADXaauNOw5M97G2vQaav49Fk-9-s-TGO971VygfcpEb7mn6eOuSz4WYRaK1k-vR678n6f8qEWHDd2wx4XiXcIUWuXKU7-kQ69xY5qgRzObO6urlXjsR3WVj1e_voq6owZ33oVO-Lzgq5A8D76OOu1yQh7_Et0%3D)
---
Peter,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**
---
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=1bb695f7558e4e0d8c483841511f9921&_e=OmGzZRHhZbBlAJKzVfg87n4WEfxVFF1bixcVOONk-lfRx9OlPnLR4bmZngRw5iWfg1Um2gKBzhRK5fc8YQ5h9TJEL8hF0Fu256bEfo_4bnRBGlpcf9TLKWkDO-Pk6mYBHv8LbrzEIPKCfeFT75hYEeTyum8WPPt3s3A3EiTG2D_9fbEHBsNOKrsHVezJxtkOK3r7E5jaL4hweqNgm7lLTvKX5btb8sGvrAeHTdTgVp3ZWDARxwualheAq1GDltkCV1OVuCNsmhNowTWWlXdT3e17sTvQQB-Ek29ikTyMSiLTMAD_L4zKHlc_4p0LklWWc8O1f30uT39KLxA8vosCh0FOE9TUoxtbcvNo7YaptGR-fXNKRfF81f3iTGzzahXggm-rPoEN91YvgPZQkUz5M-CLnRJy72M_kDNxH3sW9fUMXMGLbWnshvqcUmrKynv7Y3gLprgbQRyqOsukZgai9X2bpPEyVT0bchEJNCJCLNFdGTTwL-rptl_ogNmQWCKek-cn5N_yYBMU5w5fpEh27YXuwsV59lk_uR3rsNGgXHRIG2r_nDpDI9Ggzb-nQTaFzSv_cHV0JEUb-lRZFHgFYr6_dDEpwkvaL6X3tZ_ksAOrTz8TVHRqIuVFw2huNzFREI2HnybbACHifMnqlu4WZyoqp1zvKoWZEp1evxt3hlHSE6ZMicVCGXnzNlmY91mut68ojzRWBPKdTBp8WL-LPNF2rRNqaaX0wDoqXOgNM9CtYPw6kDx6PRkEtf-vBqCoAd_9v_OhiFK0lYdSGDGtmDbeOjzHy9Q5vRQO6taRHM8%3D)
---
**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. The strength of this launch will set the tone for our push towards October, and anything you can afford, even if it’s just $25, would be a true blessing.** ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=1bb695f7558e4e0d8c483841511f9921&_e=OmGzZRHhZbBlAJKzVfg87n4WEfxVFF1bixcVOONk-lfRx9OlPnLR4bmZngRw5iWfg1Um2gKBzhRK5fc8YQ5h9TJEL8hF0Fu256bEfo_4bnRBGlpcf9TLKWkDO-Pk6mYBHv8LbrzEIPKCfeFT75hYEeTyum8WPPt3s3A3EiTG2D_9fbEHBsNOKrsHVezJxtkOK3r7E5jaL4hweqNgm7lLTvKX5btb8sGvrAeHTdTgVp3ZWDARxwualheAq1GDltkCV1OVuCNsmhNowTWWlXdT3e17sTvQQB-Ek29ikTyMSiLIWjJD36iu3GDAuJzsgV_nD1LsB_0rxOYZVlZWZw9WIrZL_r7lGj_97jRWKcC1m1CH1chkpWzeYtf6CPLIk-gyIxb1-yOyih0zu1mMOlb7cqYZerdPbJKS98v4BJUQwhfXFmY9wJoMXsBDQxP-VLA_EUFYoj7YAH_Z2BP2o14aDjulvYR5kWp__k-Hi6L6GCeNdfHokkpUan8etWSee2vee_P8kgDVXYlbdtFORAjsHI-ZEEdx3RwZuP_UghjYbfcda656bTfJ5nQ3J6y5AwQVtwdM3SsZV5mucY_YHKW4ZlwJuBxf5MQxGvOTnMMVVQjCxtY3BXMuq35DeVj71jAod7TXG1mjiR6ZDku0Nd5rJemxGcp12W8_QENhdykhohx-5ziTf2v7N9I4YN-ooGMbceZuhtuvi_EBeR2te0keH56ytd0-VNamT15UaTVjJleMnuJovc4VCpb9p3PpOCLQD9Lb-lSykPIDrO4xX5UQY1GypCoI0pL4bfBJwWblBZU%3D)

**As we approach Memorial Day, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall** – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. **For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose.** For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates.
**While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there.** Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home.
Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – _to free the oppressed, so others may live._
Respectfully submitted,
Dennis Price
Founder & CEO
Heroes for Humanity

clean_body: For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics. | | | | | | Peter, In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California. A 12-year-old girl. Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge. Our operators physically extracted her. What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been. And underneath all of it, faith. Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started. That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive. Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team. She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – the next child is already missing. This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot. In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed: ✅ Eight American families extracted from Mexico in February. ✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March. ✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti. ✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas this January. The work goes back further. 64 evacuated from Ukraine during active combat in 2022. 58 Christians rescued from persecution across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum. For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way. So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas. The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism. Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts. Total goal: $1,000,000 by October. First milestone: $100,000. | "MAKE A GIFT TODAY" As we approach Memorial Day, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose. For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates. While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there. Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home. Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – to free the oppressed, so others may live. Respectfully submitted, Dennis Price Founder & CEO Heroes for Humanity | | | | "PLEASE DONATE" | | | | | SERVING THE VULNERABLE. SHARING THE GOSPEL. Peter, I just visited the Alligator Alcatraz immigration detention center to make sure it’s actually being shut down.

Here’s what I saw: It is slowly winding down, but over 650 humans are still being detained, held in cages, with little access to basic necessities like food, water, and showers.

Ron DeSantis and Donald Trump have spent over a billion in taxpayer dollars to carry out this failed experiment in human suffering.

Since it opened, I’ve conducted oversight at the facility three times to see the inhumane conditions myself. And I went back again and again, to expose what was happening and ensure it’s shut down.

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2303%2E5691347%2EzeOgMr)

Peter, last Tuesday, Jon Ossoff won the Democratic nomination for the U.S. Senate. Our campaign is firing on all cylinders right now, and Democrats across Georgia are united and ready for victory in November.
On the other hand... take a look at the GOP runoff between Mike Collins and Derek Dooley.
A failed congressman who’s only a congressman because his daddy was a congressman, matching up against a failed coach who was only a coach because his daddy was a coach.
They are going to spend the next month (and millions of dollars) not just attacking Jon, but attacking each other and trying to out-grovel each other for Trump’s endorsement.
_This means we have an extraordinary window of opportunity __right now__ to build a lead and get Jon’s message out all across Georgia, and make sure that whoever wins the GOP runoff will be facing off against a campaign with incredible momentum and determination._
But we have to act FAST. _Every day counts_ when we have to reach millions of Georgia voters.
So we are humbly asking: [**Can you make your first online contribution to Jon’s reelection campaign TODAY? This is the most important Senate race in the country, and we have a golden opportunity right now to build the lead that will win Georgia this November and — just like in 2021 — deliver a Democratic majority in the Senate.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260526-2-f-b&t=2&akid=2303%2E5691347%2EzeOgMr)
Thank you for chipping in, especially now.
Team Jon Ossoff

name: Barack Obama
subject: A wake-up call
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
It’s been one month since the Supreme Court gutted a key pillar of the Voting Rights Act, and what’s happened since is a legitimate crisis for democracy.

---
Hey Peter, It’s been one month since the Supreme Court dismantled key parts of the Voting Rights Act. Within hours of the ruling, lawmakers in multiple states started the process of systematically weakening the voting power of Black and brown Americans — all in an effort to gain an extra advantage in the midterms. **This should be a wake-up call for everyone who believes in fairness and equality. It should unsettle all of us who have faith in the American experiment, and the bedrock principle that every citizen should play a role in shaping our future. ** Republicans are trying to undermine democracy because they care more about holding power than improving the lives of their constituents. But no matter what they may want us to believe, the most powerful title in this country is citizen. We get to decide where we go from here. **The weeks and months ahead will be tough. We will win some fights, and we may lose others. ** But when we look back at this moment years from now, we should feel confident that we did everything we could to protect and strengthen our democracy. [**Let’s roll up our sleeves and do the hard work of preserving the right of every American to make their voices heard. | | | Friend,
---
For years, the Left thought they had a permanent grip on America's youth.

And honestly?

For a while, they did.
They dominated classrooms. Social media. Pop culture. Hollywood. Universities.

They told an entire generation that loving your country was shameful...

That faith was outdated... And traditional values were something to erase.

But thanks to Charlie's leadership, something incredible has happened:

Young men are rejecting the Left in RECORD numbers. High school boys are the most Conservative they've been in 50 years.

And Gen Z is heading back to church -- in numbers greater than their parents' or grandparents' generations.

For the first time in decades, we are WINNING the American Culture War.

**But there 's still one group the Left is desperately fighting to hold onto: **

_America 's young women. _

Because they know something very important, Friend...

If they can win the hearts and minds of young women...

They don't just shape individuals. They shape families. They shape homes. They shape future generations.

**And that 's exactly why Turning Point USA's Women's Leadership Summit (WLS) matters more than ever this year. **

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f2c25faccdb346d49770805d720ddbe8&_e=WzBYP3k9yJdXv8IBwllhpzSFrmkN9qDSakL3rlPA4yM8hLIC2-a7ZFOA1NCCudKrUKH-s7nCawsjZPSPBMo27kRAakwQughxESKeb3-MbWlJ-IpaD4oJt6r2l1_lVh7zshad5E29aPg0-KIXeokvQ-QlZJ0b25rUdo3EGxd3qSNf4ohC7jR981gqE6IsEOmJ4xiZQGks2VisakucM34ZeXx6Mpk0bJHmGpzk3Uwyj290dTVu_b6dZYQdYeCr2TQqaIYM5G53s0b6DnRUx4THOoEJ6-SqxORJ4ZSLsKUK-TaqAqWav0_6Dl0_XbY-84eyh8zcplJd4s7c4sXF1HSAobtM2yvo1lstkzkbyNOyHHIiep3vfKcUFJgQWY1BgdT46rqbYHmhED748Qfx4vq5uFqsQyih-xcTZK3KXw6aZ70XEXDt8ii7E89r9MpoBwp2G0vvc6oQBIVQ0XRREfK2eTj0RcmMgcSNG1pZyejeiUqoe0i13LEm_FlTqHXSkMS2m67u3IohRLAmd2v14ByXIm9oD2qEoqUMuLVzHhn5RkxKw4-5XMPqoSrejmjFT07sNLmqR2ssG1eI4YwZysAHsDZfeCvOD4i4SC_QC3Xy9kHzOcNV929gnzQQ7NJVo3pHOT8MhrBFI8Aj5Fqc5239Ko_w9IHFM6CtJc0aVm692bUVfWZJqenQjgK-sx_TCn4a)

I've spent the last 7 years helping lead the team behind Turning Point USA's biggest events.

And I can honestly tell you:

I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now.

Because modern culture is failing them.

The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment."

They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism.

And after years of hearing those lies...

So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty.

They're searching for something REAL.

Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down.

_That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. _

Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage.

**From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: **

✅ Strengthen their minds
✅ Cultivate wellness
✅ Step boldly into their purpose
✅ Anchor their spirits in faith

And when they walk into that room... _Something changes. _

Young women arriving unsure of themselves...

_Then leaving with fire in their eyes. _

Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing:

_" There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." _

That matters.

Because the Left wants these young women isolated.

Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate.

But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger.

**A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. **

And these women don't just leave inspired... _They go home ready to LEAD. _

I've watched women leave WLS and:

🔥 Strengthen their faith
🔥 Embrace their femininity
🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose
🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses
🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters
🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement

This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time.

And I can honestly tell you: I've never seen young women hungrier for truth, purpose, faith, wellness, and real community than they are right now. Because modern culture is failing them. The Left sold them confusion and called it "empowerment." They told young women: femininity is weakness, motherhood is oppression, faith is foolish, patriotism is toxic, and healthy living is extremism. And after years of hearing those lies... So many young women feel exhausted. Lonely. Anxious. Spiritually empty. They're searching for something REAL. Somewhere they can breathe again. Somewhere they can grow stronger instead of being torn down. That 's what Women's Leadership Summit has become. Not just another event... but a place where thousands of women come together to rediscover truth, confidence, purpose, and courage. From June 5 -7 in San Antonio, women from across the country will gather to: ✅ Strengthen their minds ✅ Cultivate wellness ✅ Step boldly into their purpose ✅ Anchor their spirits in faith And when they walk into that room... Something changes. Friend, I see it happen every year -- and from backstage, you can actually watch the change happen in real time. Young women arriving unsure of themselves... Then leaving with fire in their eyes. Women who thought they were alone suddenly realizing: " There are thousands of other women who love God, love Freedom, and LOVE AMERICA just like I do." That matters. Because the Left wants these young women isolated. Disconnected. Demoralized. Easy to manipulate. But WLS reminds them they are part of something MUCH bigger. A movement. A sisterhood. A generation of strong, patriotic women rising up to reject the lies they 've been fed for years. And these women don't just leave inspired... They go home ready to LEAD. I've watched women leave WLS and: 🔥 Strengthen their faith 🔥 Embrace their femininity 🔥 Build friendships rooted in truth and purpose 🔥 Boldly speak out on their campuses 🔥 Launch Turning Point USA chapters 🔥 Lead in their communities and in this movement This is how we WIN the culture war. One fearless young woman at a time. But here 's the problem, Friend... Right now, we have many young women who desperately want to attend WLS but may miss this life-changing experience without help. Some are students working to save enough money for gas or airfare. Others are trapped in environments where they constantly feel pressured to stay silent about their beliefs. And many just need ONE place where they can be surrounded by women who will encourage them, strengthen them, and remind them they were created for MORE. But there 's not much time left before the doors open... I truly believe Women's Leadership Summit can change the trajectory of a young woman's life... That's why I'm personally asking: For many young women, attending WLS is the moment everything starts to change. The moment they realize they are NOT alone. The moment they stop apologizing for loving God, loving freedom, and loving America. The moment they begin stepping boldly into the life and purpose they were created for. Because if we want to save this country... We MUST reach America 's young women before the Left does. That's the mission. And I believe with all my heart that the Women's Leadership Summit is a launching pad for the future mothers, leaders, creators, and culture-shapers who will determine where this country goes next. Please help us make sure no young woman is left behind. Let's fill San Antonio with women ready to LIVE boldly... Stand confidently in truth... LOVE AMERICA again... And help WIN the American Culture War. | | | For Charlie, Lauren Toncich Vice President of EventsTurning Point USA P.S. clean_body: | Remember that email I sent you a few weeks ago? Telling you I’d be hosting a cooking event online for recurring contributors to my campaign? Well, Peter, the date is set, and we’re putting together the plan and the shopping list for participants! But before we send out the date, time, and ingredients, I’m doing one more ask: = = Here’s some more info: \---------- Forwarded message --------- It’s no secret that I love to cook, Peter, = I also love my team — folks like you, Peter, who continue to support me month after month. So, I decided I want to cook with you! Later this quarter, I’ll be hosting a Zoom call where recurring donors will be invited to come and cook alongside me while we talk about things going on in the district and DC — politics and otherwise. = = Here’s how it is going to work: a few weeks ahead of time, my team will email recurring donors a link to register for the event and a shopping list. That’s where you’ll find all the ingredients you need. Things can get pretty heavy in today’s political climate, but cooking in community is a nice way to find some peace. I hope you can join us! – Emily Randall | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. She grew up in a working-class Union household in Port Orchard and was the first in her family to attend college. After serving in the State Senate and passing nearly 200 bills, Emily made history in 2024 as the first queer Latina elected to Congress. Now, Emily is fighting for WA working families in D.C. and organizing to take back the House.
